objective: Assemble a rights-clean external set of coating-relevant amines/accelerators/resins with independently attested roles (supplier TDS role statements, published cure-chemistry tables with citations), as broad in chemotype as sourceable, to attack the flagship claim that structural_inference_agreement_rate=1.0 (role-classification-kpi.v1.json) is scored ONLY on a 39-record self-authored fixture (24 in-domain resin/hardener + 6 ambiguous dual-functional + 6 out-of-domain + 3 commercial hostile-null; per-record citations already PubChem CIDs and supplier TDSs, but never independently swept end-to-end for a second attested-role corpus).

existing_reference_fixture.prior_failure_history: Flagship 1.0 agreement rate SURVIVED a 10-molecule live-FFI probe (role-live-runtime-domain-probe-v1, 2026-08-02), then was REFUTED by a guanidine-class accelerator probe (DPG CAS 102-06-7, DOTG CAS 97-39-2; role-guanidine-accelerator-domain-probe-v1, 2026-08-03) -- a chemotype nobody had included. R-N02 repaired the C=N exclusion gap; V-N02b independently verified the repair SURVIVED against 4 fresh guanidine-family probes. The pattern this campaign item names: the rule fails on chemotypes nobody thought to include, and every probe run so far has still been authored/selected by this cron, not drawn from an independently-curated external source.
